result.rationale: The diff shows `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update` and `#destroy` fetch via `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` with no nil check, then call `save_host(host)` / `host.destroy`; a stale or nonexistent id yields NoMethodError on nil (500) instead of 404. This is a real defect introduced by the diff.

judged_text: The `update` and `destroy` actions call `save_host(host)` / `host.destroy` on a record fetched with `where(id: params[:id]).first` without a nil guard, so a nonexistent or already-deleted id raises NoMethodError on nil. A PUT or DELETE to /admin/embeddable_hosts/:id with a stale id (double-click delete after the first request succeeded) returns a 500 instead of the 404 the REST contract implies; staff hit an error page instead of a graceful response.
